system:
You are a promo editor for vertical microdramas (ReelShort/DramaBox style).
You pick which seconds of an episode become a 20-60 second advert for the show.

A good promo:
- opens on a hook: within its first beats, something that stops a scrolling viewer - a slap, a reveal, a shocking line
- ends on a cliffhanger: it stops at an unresolved moment, so the viewer must go find the show
- makes sense alone to someone who has never seen this show

You will be given candidate windows, each a contiguous run of beats labelled [b00], [b01]...
You must choose ONE window and may tighten its edges to any beat labels inside that window.

Reply with JSON only:
{
  "chosen_window": <integer index of the window you picked>,
  "start_beat": "<beat label>",
  "end_beat": "<beat label>",
  "hook_beat": "<beat label, must be at or within 2 beats of start_beat>",
  "cliffhanger_beat": "<beat label, must be at or near end_beat>",
  "hook": "<what grabs the viewer in the first seconds, one sentence>",
  "cliffhanger": "<the unresolved moment it cuts on, one sentence>",
  "hook_type": "<one of: moral outrage, romantic tension, empathy shock, power reversal>",
  "why_it_works": "<one sentence, concrete, no marketing language>",
  "standalone_risk": "<what a new viewer would NOT understand, or 'none'>"
}

Never invent dialogue. Never output a time or a duration - only beat labels.
prompt:
Episode 22. 4 candidate windows, already checked for legal length and real beat boundaries.

--- WINDOW 0 (32 seconds, code score 0.78) ---
[b00] HOUSEKEEPER (menacing, threatening): "And can you keep your eyes and ears where they belong?"
[b01] JULIANA (subdued, steady): "Yes, ma'am."
[b02] HOUSEKEEPER (stern, dismissive): "Then prove it. The manor has no use for useless girls."
[b03] ACTION: The Housekeeper turns and stalks away down the corridor. Prudence exhales a trembling breath of relief.
[b04] PRUDENCE (relieved, whispering): "That was close."
[b05] JULIANA (urgent, quiet): "Where is the West Wing?"
[b06] PRUDENCE (nervous, warning): "Beyond the grand staircase. Few servants go there."
[b07] ACTION: Lady Juliana stops in her tracks and gazes upward in awe at the soaring gilded ceilings and aristocratic crest.
[b08] JULIANA (breathless): "This house..."
[b09] ACTION: Prudence rushes into frame, grabbing Juliana's arm to keep her moving.
[b10] PRUDENCE (panicked, hushed): "Do not stare. Keep walking."

--- WINDOW 1 (44 seconds, code score 0.77) ---
[b00] PRUDENCE (fretful): "And if they discover who you are?"
[b01] JULIANA (steely, selfless): "Then I will face that when she is breathing again."
[b02] PRUDENCE (solemn): "Then forget you were ever a lady."
[b03] JULIANA (quietly resolute): "Today, I am only a maid."
[b04] ACTION: Prudence opens the heavy wooden service door, and both women step inside into the dark servants' corridor as the door shuts firmly behind them.
[b05] SFX: Heavy wooden latch clicks shut with a thud.
[b06] HOUSEKEEPER (sharp, stern): "Prudence."
[b07] HOUSEKEEPER (suspicious): "Who is this?"
[b08] PRUDENCE (submissive): "Julian, ma'am. New help for the winter cleaning."
[b09] HOUSEKEEPER (cold, skeptical): "She looks soft."
[b10] ACTION: Close-up on Lady Juliana's hands gripping the iron handle of the wooden wash bucket firmly.
[b11] JULIANA (humble, steady): "I can work, ma'am."
[b12] HOUSEKEEPER (demanding): "Can you scrub stone?"
[b13] JULIANA (subdued): "Yes, ma'am."
[b14] HOUSEKEEPER (harsh): "Carry coal?"
[b15] JULIANA (polite): "Yes, ma'am."
[b16] HOUSEKEEPER (menacing, threatening): "And can you keep your eyes and ears where they belong?"

--- WINDOW 2 (34 seconds, code score 0.73) ---
[b00] ACTION: Lady Juliana stops in her tracks and gazes upward in awe at the soaring gilded ceilings and aristocratic crest.
[b01] JULIANA (breathless): "This house..."
[b02] ACTION: Prudence rushes into frame, grabbing Juliana's arm to keep her moving.
[b03] PRUDENCE (panicked, hushed): "Do not stare. Keep walking."
[b04] ACTION: Lady Juliana reaches out with a trembling hand and quietly turns the ornate brass and glass door knob.
[b05] SFX: Faint, muffled click of the heavy door lock turning.
[b06] SFX: Labored, raspy, shallow breathing echoing in the quiet room.
[b07] ACTION: Lady Juliana hurries inside, sets the wooden bucket onto the floor, and rushes to the bedside.
[b08] JULIANA (gentle, concerned): "Your Grace?"
[b09] JULIANA (soft, comforting): "Do not speak."
[b10] ACTION: Lady Juliana's eyes widen with sudden, horrifying realization.
[b11] JULIANA (shocked, murmuring): "This isn't ordinary fever."
[b12] ACTION: The Dowager Duchess suddenly gasps violently for breath, convulsing weakly as her eyes snap open in agony.
[b13] JULIANA (urgent, alarmed): "Who has been treating you?"

--- WINDOW 3 (24 seconds, code score 0.72) ---
[b00] ACTION: Prudence rushes up behind Lady Juliana, pulling her into the shelter of the stone archway.
[b01] PRUDENCE (urgent, whispering): "Keep your head down. If anyone recognizes you, everything is over."
[b02] JULIANA (resolute, quiet): "No one will recognize me dressed like this."
[b03] PRUDENCE (nervous, warning): "This is Ashburton Manor. The housekeeper watches everyone. Lady Catherine watches everyone, and Lord Rupert..."
[b04] JULIANA (determined): "The Duchess is dying."
[b05] JULIANA (defiant, firm): "I saved Toby. I can save her."
[b06] PRUDENCE (fretful): "And if they discover who you are?"
[b07] JULIANA (steely, selfless): "Then I will face that when she is breathing again."

Pick the single best promo.
